note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 26 November 2026, RealHunt lists 21 homes for sale in Germany, each one checked by a person.
In Germany, the median asking price of those 21 homes is €55,000 (€1,053 per m², from the 21 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €40,000 and the most expensive €199,000.
Taxes and fees add about 5–8.5% to the price of a home in Germany (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: Real estate transfer tax (Grunderwerbsteuer) of 3.5% to 6.5% depending on the state (3.5% in Bavaria, 6.5% in Brandenburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Saarland and Schleswig-Holstein), plus notary and land registry fees (Notar- und Grundbuchkosten) of about 1.5-2%; if the seller hired the agent, the buyer pays half the commission by law, which is extra.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes. There are no restrictions on foreigners buying property in Germany, though non-EU buyers usually need a bigger down payment to get a loan.
buying.annual_property_tax: Owners pay property tax (Grundsteuer), calculated since 2025 as assessed value x a tax rate x a municipal multiplier (Hebesatz) that each municipality sets.
buying.rental_income_tax: Non-resident owners are taxed in Germany on net rental income at the normal progressive income tax rates, but without the basic tax-free allowance (Grundfreibetrag).

homes.title: Sunny attic flat with a balcony for €40,000 in Chemnitz
homes.title_es: Ático soleado con balcón por 40.000 € en Chemnitz
homes.summary: 54 m² under the roof of a well-kept 1930s building, 4.4 km from the centre: a hallway, a living room, a bedroom, a daylight bathroom with a bath and a kitchen opening onto a balcony over a quiet courtyard. Laminate and tiles; the balcony decking is due to be replaced by the owners' association. Asking €40,000, about €742/m².

homes.title: 72 m² flat in a listed building near the university, vacant
homes.title_es: Piso de 72 m² en un edificio protegido junto a la universidad, vacío
homes.summary: 71.8 m² on the 3rd floor of a listed building (renovated around 1994) in Schloßchemnitz, close to the centre and the university: a large kitchen, a living room, a bedroom and a big daylight bathroom with a bath and a shower. Freshly painted, laminate floors, free now. About €695/m². Asking €50,000, about €696/m².

homes.title: 65 m² attic flat with skylights and a balcony in Chemnitz-Gablenz
homes.title_es: Ático de 65 m² con ventanas de tejado y balcón en Chemnitz-Gablenz
homes.summary: A spacious two-room attic flat in a renovated building on a quiet side street: laminate floors, a bright living room under skylights, a daylight bathroom with a bath, a balcony over the courtyard with long views, a cellar and a storeroom. A few minutes from the university. Asking €55,000, about €844/m².

homes.title: Three-room 71 m² flat with new floors, 10 km from Saarbrücken
homes.title_es: Piso de tres habitaciones y 71 m² con suelos nuevos, a 10 km de Saarbrücken
homes.summary: 71.3 m² on the 1st floor of a four-flat building in Fischbach: a large living room, a bedroom, a children's room or office, a kitchen, a shower room, a storeroom and a cellar. Bright, with new laminate throughout; about 10 minutes by car from Saarbrücken. Asking €55,000, about €771/m².

homes.title: Renovated two-room flat with a new kitchen and garden in the Kaßberg
homes.title_es: Piso de dos habitaciones reformado con cocina nueva y jardín en el Kaßberg
homes.summary: 49.5 m² on the ground floor of a 1912 period building on a leafy Kaßberg street: an open living and dining room with a new white fitted kitchen, a bedroom, a tiled bathroom with a bath and a shared garden. Vacant and ready to move in. Asking €45,000, about €909/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated period flat with a south balcony
homes.title_es: Piso de época reformado por completo con balcón al sur
homes.summary: 65.8 m² on the 3rd floor of a 1900 building: high ceilings, new floors, a fitted kitchen, a bathroom with a bath and a large south balcony over the courtyard. Fully renovated and currently let to a tenant. Asking €55,000, about €836/m².

homes.title: Move-in-ready three-room flat with a loggia over the city park in Chemnitz
homes.title_es: Piso de tres habitaciones listo para entrar, con logia sobre el parque, en Chemnitz
homes.summary: 55.8 m² on the 5th floor of a renovated 1987 building right on the Stadtpark: three rooms, a bathroom with a bath and a south-east loggia looking over the trees. District heating, energy class B, cellar. Free from September 2026; service charge about €267 a month, no lift. Asking €50,000, about €896/m².

homes.title: Three-room flat with a balcony over the green, no buyer's commission
homes.title_es: Piso de tres habitaciones con balcón a zona verde, sin comisión
homes.summary: 57 m² on the 3rd floor of a block renovated in 1994/95: a living room with a dining corner, a double bedroom, a children's room, a bathroom with a bath and a large balcony looking over open country. District heating, energy class B, no buyer's commission; free from November 2026. Two photos are styled examples. Asking €50,000, about €872/m².

homes.title: Art nouveau studio with a lift, fitted kitchen and carport in Chemnitz
homes.title_es: Estudio modernista con ascensor, cocina equipada y plaza cubierta en Chemnitz
homes.summary: 41 m² on the 2nd floor of a brick art nouveau building with a lift and a garden: a bright living-sleeping room, a fitted kitchen, a daylight bathroom with a bath, a cellar and a carport space included in the price. Currently let (about €305 a month). Asking €45,000, about €1,088/m².

homes.title: Modernised three-room flat with a green-view balcony in Chemnitz
homes.title_es: Piso de tres habitaciones modernizado con balcón a zona verde en Chemnitz
homes.summary: 57 m² on the 3rd floor, fully modernised in 2016: new bathroom and pipes, new wiring, wider doorways with new doors, laminate floors and a 2017 fitted kitchen. Living room with a south-east balcony over the park, two more rooms and a cellar. Vacant, so you can move straight in. Asking €55,000, about €965/m².

homes.title: Empty, ready-to-move-in studio for €40,000 in Chemnitz, no commission
homes.title_es: Estudio vacío y listo para entrar por 40.000 € en Chemnitz, sin comisión
homes.summary: 40.8 m² on the 2nd floor of a 1998 building in Sonnenberg, sold privately with no commission: a bright room with three windows facing different ways, a kitchen, a tiled bathroom, laminate floors and gas central heating. Shops and schools next door. Asking €40,000, about €980/m².

homes.title: Renovated studio with a big balcony and lift in Krefeld
homes.title_es: Estudio reformado con balcón grande y ascensor en Krefeld
homes.summary: 30 m² on the 3rd floor of a building with a lift: a bright room opening onto a large balcony, a new shower room, new floors and a cellar. Sold with furniture; it can be handed over empty or with the current tenant (€700 a month all-in). No buyer's commission. Asking €50,000, about €1,667/m².

homes.title: Furnished flat in a listed 1890 landmark on the Kaßberg, Chemnitz
homes.title_es: Piso amueblado en un edificio histórico de 1890 en el Kaßberg, Chemnitz
homes.summary: 41 m² on the 3rd floor of the listed building at Gerhart-Hauptmann-Platz 1, one of the few on the square to survive the war, restored in 1998: a furnished room with a sleeping loft, a red fitted kitchen and an Italian marble bathroom. Sold privately by the original owners, no commission; it has been let furnished. Asking €50,000, about €1,220/m².

homes.title: Furnished studio on a quiet street in Wuppertal-Langerfeld
homes.title_es: Estudio amueblado en una calle tranquila de Wuppertal-Langerfeld
homes.summary: 34 m² on the 1st floor: a living-sleeping room, a fitted kitchen with a dining table, a shower room and a cellar. Quiet residential street with good bus links into Wuppertal; service charge €340 a month. Asking €50,000, about €1,471/m².

homes.title: Two-room flat in a red-brick period building in Chemnitz-Altendorf
homes.title_es: Piso de dos habitaciones en un edificio de época de ladrillo rojo en Chemnitz-Altendorf
homes.summary: 51.4 m² on the 1st floor of a well-kept period building: a living room and bedroom with laminate floors, a tiled kitchen and a bathroom with a bath, plus a cellar. Quiet street, free now; fixed buyer's commission €2,380. Asking €55,000, about €1,070/m².

homes.title: Garden-level flat with a south terrace steps from the beach on the Flensburg Fjord
homes.title_es: Apartamento a nivel del jardín con terraza sur a pasos de la playa en el fiordo de Flensburg
homes.summary: A three-room flat of about 60 m² a few steps from the beach and the Flensburg Fjord. The living room with open kitchen has floor-to-ceiling windows onto a south-facing terrace that looks over a well kept communal garden. Two further rooms work as bedrooms or an office, and the bathroom has a tub. Electric outside blinds on every window, a step-free basement storage room for bikes and beach gear, and a parking space in front. It is empty and available soon. District heating, energy class C. Monthly building fees are not given in the advert.

homes.title: Two-room flat with a balcony and underground parking in Chemnitz
homes.title_es: Piso de dos habitaciones con balcón y plaza de garaje en Chemnitz
homes.summary: 56.6 m² on the 2nd floor of a 1996 building: a bright living room with a balcony, a bedroom, a fitted kitchen and a shower room, plus a cellar and its own underground parking space. Well kept; the furniture style is older but nothing needs doing. Asking €60,000, about €1,061/m².

homes.title: Bright renovated studio in a period building on the Kaßberg, Chemnitz
homes.title_es: Estudio luminoso reformado en un edificio de época en el Kaßberg, Chemnitz
homes.summary: 38 m² on the 4th floor of a well-kept building in the Kaßberg, Chemnitz's prettiest old quarter: one large room with tall windows, new floors, a modern bathroom and a separate kitchen, plus a cellar. Freshly painted and empty, ready to furnish. Asking €55,000, about €1,447/m².

homes.title: Designer-renovated furnished studio in Magdeburg, no commission
homes.title_es: Estudio amueblado con reforma de diseño en Magdeburgo, sin comisión
homes.summary: 39 m² on the ground floor of a quiet rear building, given a full design renovation in 2021 and still like new: a high-end fitted kitchen (fridge, oven, dishwasher), a smart wall-bed system and a modern shower room. Sold furnished and let to a student at €350 a month cold rent; no buyer's commission. Asking €60,000, about €1,538/m².

homes.title: Studio with a balcony over the trees in Bremen-Kattenesch, vacant
homes.title_es: Estudio con balcón a los árboles en Bremen-Kattenesch, vacío
homes.summary: 34 m² on the 1st floor in Kattenesch, south Bremen: a bright room with a balcony facing greenery, a kitchenette, a bathroom and a hallway. Sold privately, vacant and with no buyer's commission. Asking €60,000, about €1,765/m².

homes.title: Modernised studio with a new kitchen near Gelsenkirchen centre
homes.title_es: Estudio modernizado con cocina nueva junto al centro de Gelsenkirchen
homes.summary: 30 m² on the ground floor, a short walk from the city centre: a fitted kitchen a few years old (hob, oven, fridge, washing machine), floors renewed about three years ago, a shower room and fresh paint. No buyer's commission; free from August 2026. Asking €60,000, about €2,000/m².
